mapper.select: SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) AS id,action,reason,created_at AS createdAt,CAST(actor_id AS CHAR) AS actorId FROM article_review_log WHERE article_id=#{articleId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT * FROM article_revision WHERE article_id=#{articleId} ORDER BY version_no DESC LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE article_revision SET is_current=0 WHERE article_id=#{articleId} AND is_current=1
UPDATE article_revision SET payload=#{payload},content_hash=#{contentHash},state=1,lock_version=lock_version+1,submitted_at=NOW(3),updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE revision_id=#{revisionId} AND state=0

UPDATE article_revision SET payload=#{payload},content_hash=#{contentHash},state=#{state},lock_version=lock_version+1,updated_at=NOW(3),submitted_at=IF(#{submitting}=1,NOW(3),NULL) WHERE revision_id=#{revisionId} AND state=0
mapper.select: SELECT article_id FROM article_info WHERE article_id=#{articleId} UNION ALL SELECT article_id FROM article_revision WHERE article_id=#{articleId} LIMIT 1
SELECT status FROM category WHERE category_id=#{categoryId} FOR SHARE
SELECT status,parent_id FROM category WHERE category_id=#{categoryId} FOR SHARE
SELECT * FROM article_revision WHERE revision_id=#{revisionId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM article_revision WHERE article_id=#{articleId} AND is_current=1 AND deleted=0 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM article_info WHERE article_id=#{articleId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT user_id FROM article_info WHERE article_id=#{articleId} AND deleted=0 UNION ALL SELECT author_id AS user_id FROM article_revision WHERE article_id=#{articleId} AND is_current=1 AND deleted=0 LIMIT 1
SELECT user_id FROM user_info WHERE user_id=#{userId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO article_revision(article_id,version_no,author_id,base_revision_id,state,payload,content_hash,submitted_at,is_current,data_source,required_level,client_request_id) VALUES(#{row.articleId},#{row.version},#{row.authorId},#{row.baseRevisionId},#{row.state},#{row.payload},#{row.contentHash},IF(#{row.state}=1,NOW(3),NULL),1,(SELECT data_source FROM user_info WHERE user_id=#{row.authorId}),#{row.requiredLevel},#{row.clientRequestId})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM article_revision WHERE author_id=#{userId} AND client_request_id=#{requestId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT category_id,migrated_to FROM category WHERE category_id=#{categoryId} FOR SHARE

SELECT CAST(r.article_id AS CHAR) AS articleId,CAST(r.revision_id AS CHAR) AS revisionId,r.lock_version AS lockVersion,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.payload,'$.title')) AS title,r.state FROM article_revision r LEFT JOIN article_info a ON a.article_id=r.article_id WHERE r.author_id=#{userId} AND r.deleted=0 AND r.is_current=1 AND r.state IN(0,1,3,4) AND (a.article_id IS NULL OR (a.deleted=0 AND a.status<>2)) AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.payload,'$.title')) LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC,r.article_id DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article_revision r LEFT JOIN article_info a ON a.article_id=r.article_id WHERE r.author_id=#{userId} AND r.deleted=0 AND r.is_current=1 AND r.state IN(0,1,3,4) AND (a.article_id IS NULL OR (a.deleted=0 AND a.status<>2)) AND r.state=#{state}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article_revision r LEFT JOIN article_info a ON a.article_id=r.article_id LEFT JOIN user_info u ON u.user_id=r.author_id WHERE r.deleted=0 AND (a.article_id IS NULL OR a.deleted=0) AND r.state=#{state}
